paper_title: Dual Modality-Aware Gated Prompt Tuning for Few-Shot Multimodal Sarcasm   Detection
caption: Effect of Prompt Depth
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the relationship between prompt depth and accuracy for two models, “mmsd” and “mmsd2”. The x-axis is labeled "Prompt Depth (J)" and has a linear scale ranging from 1 to 10, with tick labels at integer values. The y-axis is labeled "Accuracy (%)" and has a linear scale ranging from 73 to 81, with tick labels at intervals of 1. The first line, representing "mmsd", is orange, dashed, and marked with square symbols; it begins at approximately 80.5% accuracy at a prompt depth of 1, remains relatively stable fluctuating around 80.5% to 81% until a prompt depth of 8, then declines to approximately 78.5% at a prompt depth of 10. The second line, representing “mmsd2”, is blue, solid, and marked with circular symbols; it starts at approximately 76.5% accuracy at a prompt depth of 1, decreases to approximately 74% at a prompt depth of 4, then increases to approximately 77% at a prompt depth of 6, before decreasing to approximately 75% at a prompt depth of 10.
